name: Attendance sheet
description: Handwritten meeting attendance sheet: one row per person (name, role, phone number, signature)

name.hint: The person's full name as written

role.hint: Their role in the group, e.g. Chair, Treasurer, Secretary or Member

phone.hint: Phone number exactly as written, keeping leading zeros and spaces (e.g. 0712 440 983)

signed.hint: True only if that row's signature cell has a signature or clear mark, false if it is empty
